PluginData.Author: CHKNFRYRMN
PluginData.Tooltip: Removes the frame from the edge of windows.
PluginData.Description:
This is Window Frame Be Gone!
This mod replaces the normal vanilla windows with frameless versions while keeping their original functionality.
Existing builds that use vanilla windows will automatically use the frameless models when this mod is enabled.
If you want the frameless windows as separate blocks instead of replacing vanilla ones, use the Separate Blocks Version.
